registered: 2026-10-21, first increment B (N0 essential, shadow). Source: docs/plans/needs-model-inventory-n0.md section (b). Owner: verify the inventory's incompatibilities without claiming to resolve those outside the essential model.

statuses.represented_and_tested: the shadow model (src/need_model_n0.ts) represents the distinction and a test pins it
statuses.represented_owner_decision: represented according to a recorded owner decision; a test pins the representation
statuses.outside_essential_model: not resolved here: it belongs to a module or decision outside the essential model; reason given

items.title: 'don't need X' has four meanings
items.note: not_needed is force optional, never excluded; the operational readers (phase248, phase253, phase165, phase125) keep their behaviour: shadow

items.title: 'don't want X' / 'without X'; no rejected-feature slot
items.note: unwanted with strength undetermined; excluded only with a necessity modal; the rejected function is an item with its stance, and the operational positive reading is reported as a conflict (the frozen path is unchanged)

items.title: when a stated requirement may apply
covers: tests/i1_need_model_n0.test.ts: content kinds and force (a clear stated limit is a requirement)
items.note: phase168/98 confirmation events are off the path and unchanged

items.title: 'candidate' means two different things
covers: need_model_n0 vocabulary: force 'undetermined' (ask) is separate from epistemic 'experimental_unverified'
items.note: phase127's internal contradiction (off path) is not changed

items.title: default role of a positive mention
covers: tests/i1_need_model_n0.test.ts: a named feature is a wanted function with force from its own cue (preference), never a requirement by default

items.title: 'important' has two bases
items.why: importance weights belong to ranking inputs (needs_discovery, phase168, phase97), which are off the request path and blocked; the essential model carries no weights

items.title: optional is lost in session state
items.why: the model has the value (not_needed / optional) but session state (phase164) is a dialogue module outside the essential model

items.title: feature/outcome lane decided by different authorities
items.why: the model records the producer of each item (store concept kind, functions vocabulary, scope reader), so the deciding authority is visible; choosing one authority is an owner decision, not taken here. Example: 'milk frother' is a component word taught as an alias of the task milk_drinks

items.title: relation kinds lost to Phase116
items.note: the model reads the 247 relations through needKnowledge269, never the 116 model

items.title: sufficiency spelling ('establishes' vs 'established')
items.why: an assessment-input vs derived-state naming of phase247, not a need representation

items.title: two types named QualitativeNeed
items.why: a naming collision between two off-path modules (phase96, qualitative_needs); renaming is not needed by the essential model

items.title: indifference vs rejection
covers: tests/i1_need_model_n0.test.ts: X2 indifference; mop 'don't mind' indifferent vs 'don't want' unwanted

items.title: questions
items.why: question integration must keep the Phase126/127 checks (owner); the model only marks what is undetermined (force 'undetermined', strength 'undetermined')

items.title: granularity of evidence requirements
covers: tests/i1_need_model_n0.test.ts: per-need measures, conditions and proxies

items.title: lab_needs_bridge header claim
items.why: documentation of an off-path module; not a representation the model uses
